name: dsh-desktop-pet
description: A desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: its own persona, lorebook and multimodal API, a user profile distilled from the harness's own chat history, awareness of the running task, proactive chatter, reminders, voice, 8-24 frame sprite animations, screen reading and computer control behind a three-level permission, and a click-to-talk desktop window (WinForms sprite or Edge app window) next to the in-app floating pet.
